We chose Coinbase infrastructure because it enables us to sponsor transaction fees on Base. HEVN users can complete onchain transactions without holding ETH, calculating gas costs, or dealing with blockchain complexity. This gives customers a predictable, gasless experience while allowing us to build on Base’s fast and cost-efficient settlement infrastructure.

We chose Stripe partly because it gives us access to Privy, a Stripe company, for embedded non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Privy lets us provide wallets directly inside HEVN while users retain ultimate control of their assets and private keys. Its secure-enclave architecture and programmable authorization controls give us the security and flexibility required for business payments without forcing customers to manage seed phrases or separate wallet applications. This allowed us to deliver a reliable cryptocurrency experience without building sensitive wallet infrastructure from scratch.

Hi Product Hunt! 👋 We built HEVN U.S. Accounts after seeing international businesses lose days to bank emails, manual paperwork, unclear transfer statuses, and failed USD payments. For importers, exporters, commodity traders, and manufacturers, a delayed payment can hold up an entire shipment. Global trade moves continuously, but traditional banking often does not. HEVN gives eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD accounts through U.S. sponsor banks. Businesses can hold USD, receive payments via Fedwire, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported international payments from one platform. We would love your feedback.
